data.action: 仰头立于花帘下，花瓣落发，转身浅笑藏悲
data.camera: medium shot, wisteria canopy, petal light, bittersweet mood
data.description: 【藤园·满开午后】紫藤花帘垂落如瀑，忍站在花架下仰头让花影落在脸上。她忽然开口，声音轻得像花瓣——「紫藤花的毒对鬼致命……对我也一样哦。所以呐，在我还笑得出来的日子里……要一起看更多、更多的花才行。」转过身来，微笑之下第一次露出了真实的悲伤。
data.lighting: 紫藤花帘过滤的淡紫光
data.promptProse: Shinobu Kocho looks up beneath the garden's hanging wisteria, then turns toward her companion with a smile that briefly reveals sadness. Her butterfly haori lies over the black Demon Slayer uniform, the hair ornament clear among falling petals. The medium view follows the trellis posts and violet flower curtains behind. Afternoon light filtered through blossoms colors her cheek and white haori lavender, with denser shade beneath the canopy's overlapping clusters.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 紫藤花下的秘密·「紫藤花的毒，对鬼和对我都一样呢」
